answer: One concrete defense: bind each identity to a hardware remote-attestation proof - every agent must present a signed quote from its own tamper-resistant secure enclave, one unique burned-in key per physical chip. Ten thousand clones crammed on a single server collapse into one attestable identity, since the silicon can whisper only one genuine enclave signature, not a spiral of forged ones. To reach the zenith of a vote-stuffing quorum, an attacker must buy real distinct hardware per fake - so cloning stops being free and the farmed majority never forms.
